column1: # Divergence registry: deliberate differences from MuJoCo 3.5.0, each with the test that shows it. Every
# `divergence=<ID>` note in verdicts.tsv names an ID here (mujoco_conformance/layer_e_census.rs checks it);
# a row no note names is a difference no census doc exercises.
# kind: stricter (we refuse what MuJoCo accepts) · limitation (MuJoCo does what we cannot) ·
#       no-effect (accepted, with no effect) · lenient (we load where MuJoCo wrongly refuses) ·
#       wrong-value (MuJoCo computes a wrong value; the test shows ours is right) ·
#       extension (a quantity MuJoCo does not have).

column3: MuJoCo
column4: ours

column3: loads NaN and inf in keyframe and tendon springlength values
column4: refuses a non-finite number

column3: loads an <inertial> inside a <frame>
column4: refuses an <inertial> inside a <frame>

column3: steps at a timestep of zero (time stands still), a negative one (time runs backwards) and a non-finite one (time becomes NaN or inf, qpos NaN, with a bad-qpos warning)
column4: refuses a timestep that is not positive and finite in step, step1, step2, integrate, forward, forward_skip, inverse and inverse_skip, before any work (StepError::InvalidTimestep)

column3: steps an mjData made by another model unchecked (it stores the model signature and never reads it)
column4: refuses a Data made by a model of other dimensions (StepError::DataShapeMismatch)

column3: resets mjData and skips the copy for a keyframe index outside 0..nkey (mj_resetDataKeyframe)
column4: refuses the index (ResetError::InvalidKeyframeIndex) and leaves Data unchanged

column3: has no drift baseline (mjData has energy[2] only)
column4: Data::energy_initial: the total energy at the first forward pass that computes energy after make_data or a reset

column3: mj_copyData calls each plugin's copy
column4: a cloned Data (and a finite-difference scratch copy) has no plugin_data: there is no copy hook

column3: refuses a ball joint followed by a ball or hinge on its body, and a limited range with range[0] >= range[1] (a ball's range[0] must be 0); loads a NaN bound; leaves an automatic range with range[0] >= range[1], "0 0" included, unlimited
column4: Model::try_make_data also refuses a ball followed by a slide; a limited joint, tendon or activation range with an infinite bound; a NaN bound in any of them or in a ctrl or force range; and a nonzero range the MJCF builder made limited automatically with lo >= hi on a hinge, slide, tendon or actuator (MakeDataError)

column3: mjd_transitionFD takes the control and activation columns through mj_stepSkip(mjSTAGE_VEL), keeping the nominal passive force: the passive callback does not run there, and its dependence on ctrl is not in B (on act, not in A)
column4: pure finite differences take every column through a full step: the passive callback runs in each, and B holds its dependence (centered, on one hinge with one motor, 7 passive calls per call against 5)

column3: centered mjd_transitionFD gives the control columns of D the opposite sign: clampedDiff takes x_minus - x_plus (engine_derivative_fd.c:79), where its state columns and its other sensor columns take plus minus minus
column4: the control columns of D have the sign of the forward difference, centered or not

column3: mjd_transitionFD restores mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS | mjSTATE_CTRL and the warm start between columns (engine_derivative_fd.c:307), which hold no sleep state: a nudge that wakes a sleeping tree carries into the later columns, and the caller's d is left awake, so a second call on the same d differs (one hinge asleep with a motor, one awake: B by 0.061, A by 0.018)
column4: each column starts from the caller's state, the whole of it with sleep enabled, so the matrices equal those taken a column at a time from fresh copies of the state; the caller's Data is not changed

column3: under RK4, inserts a delayed sensor's sample after the stages, from the last stage's kinematics, velocities and forces, so the sample at time t is not the sensor's value at t (one-step delay on a damped hinge, from the undelayed values one step earlier: framepos 3.1e-3, the accelerometer 6.8e-2, framelinvel 5.8e-2, velocimeter 5.8e-2, actuatorvel 3.9e-2)
column4: takes the sample at the step's start state, before the stages: a sensor delayed by one timestep reads, bit for bit, the undelayed value one step earlier, under every integrator

column3: after mj_step1 then mj_step2 the accelerometer is 5.9 off mj_step's on the same trajectory, on a damped hinge: mj_step2 does not clear flg_rnepost (mj_forwardSkip does, engine_forward.c:1407), so it reads body accelerations an earlier pass left (mj_step1 computes none); clearing the flag between the two calls removes the difference (measured)
column4: step1 then step2 leave the accelerometer step leaves

column3: _resetData zeroes mocap_pos and mocap_quat (engine_io.c:1374-1375), runs the init-sleep mj_forward (:1463), then copies each mocap body's pose into them (:1507-1517): a tree that starts asleep sees every mocap body at the origin, and keeps that pass's sensor values while it sleeps
column4: the mocap bodies are at their poses during that pass

column3: an accelerometer or framelinacc on a static body (welded to the world, or mocap) reads 0 (mj_objectAcceleration returns 0 for a static body, engine_core_util.c:823-827), while the same site on a joint at rest reads gravity
column4: reads the site's proper acceleration, gravity included, whatever holds its body

column3: cfrc_int[0] adds each root's cfrc_int, held at that root's subtree centre of mass, without moving it (engine_core_smooth.c:2676-2679), so its torque mixes reference points; a torque sensor on a world site reads that sum
column4: cfrc_int[0] holds the roots' wrenches moved to the world origin; a torque sensor on a world site reads them moved to the site

column3: turns a ball joint about its anchor, jnt_pos off the body origin included (mj_kinematics1, engine_core_smooth.c:118-146)
column4: GpuPhysicsPipeline refuses every joint but a free one (GpuPipelineError::UnsupportedJointType); its public sub-pipelines (GpuModelBuffers, GpuFkPipeline and the stages after it) validate nothing and turn a ball about its body origin

column3: under RK4, wakes a sleeping tree that nothing touched, the step after it sleeps: mj_advance's sleep step evaluates the forward pass again from the velocity stage (engine_forward.c:899-905), so the tree keeps the last stage's frames while its qpos is the step's start, which the next kinematics find changed (engine_core_smooth.c:163-179); and the stages integrate a sleeping dof with the stale acceleration it keeps (:1086-1090), so the stage's forward pass finds the tree moving (engine_sleep.c:124-153). The sleep step's sensors read the last stage's positions (a resting box: 584 sleep changes in 3,000 steps; a pendulum beside it, on that step, 0.116 off)
column4: holds a tree asleep at the step's start there through the stages and the advance until a stage's forward pass wakes it (a contact, say; from that stage on it takes each stage's acceleration, as MuJoCo's, and the stages it was held through count as 0, the acceleration they moved it with, where MuJoCo's stages moved it with the one it kept), and evaluates the sleep step's forward pass from the position stage, so collision and a contact filter callback run once more on that step than in MuJoCo's, whose pass starts from the velocity stage: the tree sleeps once and stays asleep, its frames those of its qpos, the sleep step's sensors those of the step's start state

column3: with islands, copies an island's forces back to the rows and not their states (engine_forward.c:796-798; the island solve's states are in iefc_state, engine_solver.c:940), so efc_state is what the warmstart left, made at qacc_smooth (:662), or unset with the warmstart disabled: a row's state can contradict its own force (a friction-loss row inside its band reads LinearPos)
column4: each row's state is the one its solve ends with, as without islands

column3: takes acos of the cosine between the directions of a sphere or cylinder wrap's two tangent points unclamped (length_circle, engine_util_misc.c:55-71): where the cosine rounds past 1, on a segment grazing a sphere, the tendon's length is NaN; where it is exactly 1, on a segment tangent to a sphere, its acos is 0 and the cross product's sign may still ask for the long way round: the length is the straight segment's plus 2πr (ledger L185); one ulp below 1 the sign can still ask for the long way round (80 sphere and 108 cylinder wraps of the chunk 3e-2 review's 3,000 tangent segments)
column4: clamps the cosine to [-1, 1], and where it is 1 or rounds past it takes the arc as 0, never the long way round (at exactly 1 too, by the wrong-value rule): the length is finite, within the arc the clamp drops of the straight segment's (at most the radius times 1.67e-8 over 7,200 grazing segments, the chunk 3e-1 review's sweep); on the test's first two segments the straight segment's to 0 and 2.0e-12 (of 0.3 and 20); on the test's tangent sphere segment, MuJoCo's less 2πr; one ulp below 1 it goes the long way round as MuJoCo's does (recorded, not changed: the project lead's call, 2026-10-18)

column3: mj_rne writes the awake dofs only (engine_core_smooth.c:2481-2484) and mj_inverseSkip adds the rest of the sum to qfrc_inverse at every dof (engine_inverse.c:238-241), so a sleeping dof's qfrc_inverse grows call by call (a box asleep on a plane after resting: -19.62, -39.24, -58.86 on its vertical dof, where the forward pass applied 0; a box asleep from the reset keeps qacc 0 and reads 0); mjd_inverseFD's centre and points add to it in turn (DfDa -1.962e7 there) and a qpos nudge that wakes a tree carries into its later points
column4: a sleeping dof's qfrc_inverse is the forces applied there, qfrc_applied + qfrc_actuator + J'*xfrc_applied, call after call, whatever qacc it keeps (both boxes: 0), so a sleeping tree adds nothing to fwdinv's solver_fwdinv[1]; mjd_inverse_fd takes each point from the centre's whole state, its sleep state included, so DfDa is 0 at a sleeping dof's row

column3: mjd_smooth_vel clears qDeriv at the awake rows only (engine_derivative.c:1793-1800, mju_zeroSparse over dof_awake_ind), so an awake tendon over a sleeping dof adds its -b·J² to that dof's row every step (-0.27, -0.54, -0.81, -1.08); the implicit step factors the awake rows only
column4: clears every row, so a sleeping dof's row is, every step, the derivative of the damping force the passive pass computes at that dof (qfrc_damper)

column3: with fwdinv and invdiscrete under implicit or implicitfast, mj_compareFwdInv's mj_inverseSkip runs mj_discreteAcc, which writes M - h*qDeriv unfactored into qLU or qH (engine_inverse.c:115-146), and the comparison leaves it there; mj_stepSkip from the velocity stage then solves with it (mj_implicitSkip's skipfactor, engine_forward.c:1167), so mjd_transitionFD's control columns are not the step's: on the discrete chain B's largest entry moves from 0.0376 to -8062 under implicit, and B by up to 7.3e3 under implicitfast, where either flag alone leaves it bit for bit
column4: the comparison puts the forward pass's factor back after its inverse, so the transition finite differences with both flags are bit for bit those without

column3: lists 4 box-box contacts (mjc_BoxBox, engine_collision_box.c:604-1339) at census document e6ea68ac's pose after two steps of the first excitation (two equal boxes overlapping, aligned) and 5 with the first box's quaternion's w one ulp lower: the count turns on a one-ulp change of the pose
column4: the same function, the same 4 and 5 at the two poses, and MuJoCo's counts at each of 140 poses one to 256 ulps from the first (the chunk 3e-2 review); at the second step our qfrc_bias and qM are not MuJoCo's bit for bit (ledger L154: MuJoCo's qfrc_bias is up to 2.8e-17 at four translational dofs where ours is 0), which leaves our constraint forces 3.6e-15 apart, our pose at the third step ulps from MuJoCo's, and there ours lists 5, so the document's state differs from the third step on (census verdict e1:state@3, where it agreed before the port); that verdict, and 28695e44's and faa6b270's, turn on one ulp of the steps' quaternion integration (on macOS, sin or cos one ulp up, or cos one ulp down, there fails the census; Linux's libm not measured), and poses loaded from a quat reach such ties through ledger L166's ulps

column3: reads 0 from the distance sensor of some pairs that are apart: in GJK's S3D its fourth face leaves the fourth point's weight as an earlier face set it (engine_collision_gjk.c:633-643), so the weights sum past 1, the simplex is read as a tetrahedron about the origin and mjc_ccd takes the pair as touching (:2298-2299); two boxes are stopped at a tolerance of 0 (discreteGeoms, :159-167), where it happens more often (in the chunk 3e-2 review's random sample, on 261 of 4,227 turned box pairs apart and 106 of 36,923 other pairs of boxes, ellipsoids and cylinders)
column4: sets that weight to 0 (cf-geometry's gjk_distance): the sensor reads the pair's distance; on the test's three box pairs, MuJoCo's own box-box function's (mjc_BoxBox, with native CCD disabled) within 1e-12
